==Dialogue==
After completion of The Final Confrontation:
: ''"You showed my brothers and sisters remarkable compassion despite our crimes. Many of them rewarded your mercy with violence, and for that, I am sorry. I know it hasn't always been apparent, but you made the right decision."''

==Notes==
*She can be an ally during the The Final Confrontation if she is not killed during the quest [[There Goes the Neighborhood]].
*It is implied that, after the events of the aforementioned quest, she becomes the new leader of the Jade Brotherhood.
